content.comment_body: Hello, Is Modbus TCP communication supported on [product_name] PLC, or is an additional module necessary? Please advise.
Starting with [product_name] version [version_no], Modbus TCP/IP is supported in addition to Ethernet TCP/IP using the S7 protocol. The latest [product_name] now supports Modbus TCP/IP natively.

analysis.insight_summary: Users want to know if Modbus TCP communication is possible on [product_name] PLC and whether it requires extra hardware. Responses clarify that Modbus TCP/IP functionality is available in newer [product_name] versions without additional modules, improving built-in connectivity.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward support for Modbus TCP communication directly within [product_name] PLC, without needing any extra hardware.
